svg.title: How trails fade
svg.desc: After the canvas is copied to the screen, the effect's transfer mode decides what the canvas keeps for the next frame. Four strips show a spark that has moved right for fifteen frames. Cleared, as Quake does, it leaves no trail. Halved each frame, as Heat Wave does, it leaves a short trail that is gone in six frames. Kept at three quarters, as the Djinn attacks do, the trail lasts twelve frames. Lowered by a fixed step of 4, as Drain does, the trail lasts sixteen frames and stays bright to the end.
svg.text: AFTER EACH COPY, THE CANVAS IS
A spark moving right for fifteen frames,
as the canvas holds it in each mode.
No trail: only this frame's drawing.
A short trail, gone in six frames.
Longest, bright to the end: a step of 4
takes sixteen frames from the top.
the spark's way: 4 pixels a frame
